title: Civil War and Abner’s Death

questions.question: Who waxed stronger in the war between the house of Saul and David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:1 (ESV): "...David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul became weaker and weaker."

questions.question: How many sons were born to David in Hebron?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:2-5 (ESV): Lists Amnon, Chileab, Absalom, Adonijah, Shephatiah, Ithream.

questions.question: Why did Abner get angry with Ish-bosheth?
options: Ish-bosheth accused him concerning a concubine
questions.correctAnswer: Ish-bosheth accused him concerning a concubine
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:7-8 (ESV): "...And Ish-bosheth said to Abner, 'Why have you gone in to my father's concubine?' Then Abner was very angry..."

questions.question: What condition did David set for Abner to see his face?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:13 (ESV): "...one thing I require of you: you shall not see my face, unless you first bring Michal, Saul's daughter..."

questions.question: Who killed Abner?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:27 (ESV): "...Joab took him aside... and struck him there in the stomach, so that he died..."

questions.question: Who was David's firstborn son?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:2 (ESV): "And sons were born to David at Hebron: his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam of Jezreel."

questions.question: Who was the second son, born of Abigail?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:3 (ESV): "...and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel..."

questions.question: What was the name of the concubine Abner was accused of being with?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:7 (ESV): "Now Saul had a concubine whose name was Rizpah..."

questions.question: Where did Joab kill Abner?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:27 (ESV): "And when Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the midst of the gate..."

questions.question: How did David react to Abner's death?
options: He cursed Joab and mourned Abner
questions.correctAnswer: He cursed Joab and mourned Abner
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:28-31 (ESV): "...May it fall upon the head of Joab... David said... 'Tear your clothes... and mourn before Abner.'"

questions.question: Who was Michal's husband when she was taken back to David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:15 (ESV): "And Ish-bosheth sent and took her from her husband Paltiel the son of Laish."

questions.question: Where did Paltiel follow Michal to, weeping?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:16 (ESV): "But her husband went with her, weeping after her all the way to Bahurim."

questions.question: David said, "I am this day weak, though anointed king, and these men the sons of Zeruiah are too ______ for me."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:39 (ESV): "...and these men the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me."

questions.question: From where did Joab send messengers to bring Abner back?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:26 (ESV): "...and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the cistern of Sirah."

questions.question: What curse did David place on Joab's house?
options: One with a discharge, a leper, who holds a spindle, falls by sword, or lacks bread
questions.correctAnswer: One with a discharge, a leper, who holds a spindle, falls by sword, or lacks bread
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 3:29 (ESV): "...let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is leprous, or who holds a spindle, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread."

key_verse_text: There was a long war between the house of Saul and the house of David. David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul became weaker and weaker. (ESV)
